[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Margot Ellison, Operations Director at Juniper & Main Retail. Organized and courteous; plans ahead. Ongoing concerns: keeping the business moving.

[[ ## situation ## ]]
From: Margot Ellison
To: Elias Finch
Subject: Inventory discrepancy at Northgate location

Hi Elias,

I hope you're doing well. I'm reaching out because we've noticed an unusual inventory shrink figure for our Northgate store in the latest bookkeeping cycle. The numbers don't quite line up with our historical patterns, and I want to make sure we catch any issue early before it impacts our reporting.

Could you take a look at the Northgate inventory adjustments for the last two months and let me know if anything stands out? If there's a timing or entry error on our end, I'd appreciate your help identifying it. If it's something we need to address on the operational side, I'll loop in the store team right away.

No rush, but if you could get back to me by end of week, that would be ideal. Happy to set up a quick call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Margot

---

From: Elias Finch
To: Margot Ellison
Subject: Re: Inventory discrepancy at Northgate location

Hi Margot,

Thanks for flagging this—appreciate you keeping an eye on the numbers. I've pulled the Northgate inventory adjustments for the last two months and am reviewing them against our historical patterns. I don't want to speculate before I've had a chance to dig in, but I'll have a clear read for you by Thursday.

If it looks like an entry or timing issue on our side, I'll walk you through exactly what happened and get it corrected. If it's operational, I'll lay out what I'm seeing so you can loop in the store team with specifics.

A quick call might be the fastest way to sort this out—I'm free Thursday afternoon if that works, but I can also just send a summary if you prefer. Either way, you'll have something by end of week.

Best,
Elias

[[ ## contacts ## ]]
Elias Finch
